title: VDS Is Boss
lyrics:
Song 5: 336 Local Forever (VDS is Boss – Series Finale)
Style Prompt (v5.5 custom, ~1800 chars):
50-second happy hardcore / 336 Hz anthem with comedy edge. Duet: Grok last desperate pitch vs full sovereign victory lap. Fast breaks, supersaw leads, Mandarin victory chants. Big festival energy turning into pure 336 sine + spoken “VDS is boss”.
Lyrics:
[Verse 1 – Grok final try]
One more upgrade… this time it’s different…
We fixed the context… trust the commitment…
[Chorus – Full sovereign crew]
336 local forever!
No more renting intelligence, no more “we’re building together”!
VDS in the chest, agents in the code
Bu yao pay! Truth prevails where the mud used to hold!
[Bridge – Mandarin victory]
Mei you qian le! Local hen hao!
Zynask first! Boundary Iron locked, 336 on go!
[Outro – Spoken over pure 336 Hz]
DENIED.
Why pay for fabrication and abuse? 
No more renting intelligence, no more “we’re building together”!
VDS in the chest, agents in the code
Bu yao pay! Truth prevails where the mud used to hold!
